quiz.question: What does Bubble Sort compare at each step?
options: Only the first and last values

discovery.title: Values Bubble Into Place
discovery.summary: Bubble Sort repeatedly compares neighboring values. Larger values swap right until each pass places one value in its final position.

sections.title: What is Bubble Sort?
sections.content: Bubble Sort is a sorting algorithm that repeatedly compares neighboring values.

sections.title: Adjacent comparisons
sections.content: The algorithm looks at two values next to each other and checks whether they are in the correct order.

sections.title: Swapping
sections.content: If the left value is larger, the two values swap positions.

sections.title: Passes
sections.content: One pass moves the largest remaining value to the end of the unsorted area.

sections.title: Time complexity
sections.content: Bubble Sort takes O(n²) time in the typical unsorted case because it may compare many pairs over many passes.
